item.description: ### Changed - **The usage bars line up with the row above them and use more of the width.** The provider line (`CLAUDE Max 5x … $215 5:09 PM`) and the bars beneath it now start and end on the same edges, and the bars themselves are longer again — the label, percentage and reset-time columns were all wider than the text they hold. The reset time sits closer to its percentage instead of drifting off to the right.
